t: Avie Tevanian: CMU math whiz goes from Mach to NeXT to Apple Software Chief | Oral History Part 1

q.x: Must watch recollection of the history of Mach and NeXT and Apple by Avie Tevanian. Long but great. 1/2] [link] (early days)

desc:
Avie Tevanian recounts his early talent for mathematics, his pioneering work on the Mach microkernel at Carnegie Mellon, and his recruitment to NeXT after Steve Jobs discovered the project. He reflects on leading NeXT’s operating system team, guiding NEXTSTEP’s evolution, and the company’s path up to Apple’s 1996 acquisition.

Interviewed by David Brock, Hansen Hsu and John Markoff on 2017-02-21 i
